message: No detected input validation: The code reads CSV files and images directly without any schema checks, dtype assertions, value-range guards, or null/missing-value validation.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths only; there is no remote fetch, and no checksum or integrity verification is performed on any file.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to the training data at any point in the pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads EfficientNet via `EfficientNet.from_pretrained` (implied by the import and architecture usage) and loads checkpoint files with `torch.load` without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code uses StratifiedKFold to split data but performs no explicit class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomalous sample detection before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard PyTorch optimizer with no differential privacy library (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanism applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While multiple metrics (loss, accuracy, AUC) are computed and a separate test set is used, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, no isolation mechanism enforced beyond file separation, and the test set CSV is loaded without integrity verification.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads images directly via cv2.imread and passes them through a transform pipeline with no shape, range, or schema validation before feeding them to the model.

No detected output bounds checks: After applying torch.sigmoid the predicted probability is used directly with no NaN guard, bounds check, or sanity assertion before being written to the results list.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image-classification model (EfficientNet), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
